scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run build:functions && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting && sleep 60 && npx firebase-tools deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build:functions && npx firebase-tools deploy --only functions
scripts.dev:local: npm run build:functions && concurrently -n emu,vite -c blue,green "npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only functions" "vite"
